heading.en: Christ will minister to the Nephites—Nephi foresees the destruction of his people—They will speak from the dust—The Gentiles will build up false churches and secret combinations—The Lord forbids men to practice priestcrafts. About 559–545 B.C.
heading.sm: O le a auauna atu Keriso ia sa Nifaē—Ua vaai Nifae i le faafanoga o ona tagata—O le a tautatala mai i latou mai le efuefu—O le a fausia a'e e Nuuese ekalesia pepelo ma faapotopotoga faalilolilo—Ua poloaiina e le Alii tagata e taofia ona faia o taulaga pepelo. E tusa o le 559–545 T.L.M.
